notes: No xtext evidence is recorded because the pinned SysML.xtext defines no SourceEndMember. That is an absence in the pilot grammar, not a disagreement with the clause, so it is not a deviation.
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.9.3: `SourceEndMember : EndFeatureMembership = ownedRelatedElement += SourceEnd`. There is no second opinion to weigh — the pinned pilot grammar has no SourceEndMember rule, as it has none for SourceSuccession above it — so the clause is the only source. The production contributes no tokens of its own, and at most a multiplicity through SourceEnd, which is `( ownedRelationship += OwnedMultiplicity )?`. It is the end that a source succession leaves implicit: the source is the body item the succession follows, so the end exists in the model with nothing written for it.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.

Line 14 `then event occurrence return_getItems1;` follows line 13's `event occurrence call_getItems1;`. The SourceSuccession in that 'then' holds this member, which takes its form with no multiplicity and so contributes no text.
